quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of a regular sweater, when we want extra neck warmth, not your tank top. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is named after a slow, shelled animal.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your neck for extra warmth!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a turtleneck is a sweater with a high, tube-like collar.

quests.instruction: We wear this that stretches a little as we bend, run, or sit down. It is also worn instead of a belt, when we want our hands free of adjusting, but it is NOT your sunglasses. What is it?
quests.hint: They go over your shoulders, not around your waist!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: Did you know? suspenders are straps worn over the shoulders to hold up pants.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that is light and comfy for playing outside, not your hoodie. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It often has a fun design on the front.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they were originally designed as undershirts for soldiers.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part we pull up over our hair to keep the rain off our head? It is not your velcro!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A hoodie gets its name from this exact part.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Hood is the part that pulls up over your head to keep rain off!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a hood is a head covering attached to a jacket or sweatshirt.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of a pullover sweater, so it is easy to take on and off, not your hoodie. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is a kind of sweater, but different from one you pull over your head.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Cardigan opens down the front with buttons, making it easy to put on!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a cardigan is a sweater that opens completely in the front.

quests.instruction: We wear this that needs no belt, since the straps hold it up, but it is not your leggings. What is it?
quests.hint: They cover your chest as well as your legs.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: Did you know? overalls are pants that have a bib and straps over the shoulders.

quests.instruction: We wear this that buckles snugly around our chest for water safety. It is also worn on a canoe or sailboat, to stay safe near deep water, but it is NOT your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: It helps you float on water!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a life jacket is filled with special foam that floats on water.

quests.instruction: We wear this that swooshes dramatically every time we spin around. It is also worn instead of a jacket, for a bold, heroic look, but it is NOT your gloves. What is it?
quests.hint: It ties at your neck and flows out behind you!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a cape is a sleeveless garment that hangs over the back and shoulders.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is thick, puffy, and keeps every part of us warm at once. It is also worn instead of just a coat, for a whole day of playing in deep snow, but it is NOT your raincoat. What is it?
quests.hint: It covers your WHOLE body, all in one piece!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a snowsuit is a heavily insulated outfit for playing in the snow.

quests.instruction: We wear this before we skateboard, ski, or ride a scooter. It is also worn on our head to stay safe while riding a bike, but it is NOT your earmuffs. What is it?
quests.hint: It keeps your head safe during sports!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a helmet is a hard hat designed to protect your brain from injury.

quests.instruction: We wear this after playing sports, to stay warm while we cool down. It is also worn instead of a hoodie, when we want warmth without a hood, but it is NOT your shirt. What is it?
quests.hint: It is thick and warm, but has NO hood!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: Did you know? sweatshirts are thick, long-sleeved shirts meant to keep you warm.

quests.instruction: We wear this under a dress or skirt for extra warmth. It is NOT your tights. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are stretchy and hug your legs closely!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Did you know? leggings are skin-tight pants made of stretchy material.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this to keep warm without wearing a heavy coat, not your poncho. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It keeps the wind from making you shiver.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Did you know? many jackets have zippers so you can put them on quickly.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the snug strip of fabric that circles the very top of our pants? It is also the part of shorts or a skirt that sits right on our waist, but it is NOT your pocket!
quests.hint: Think about this: It circles around your middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Waistband is the snug strip of fabric at the top of pants, around your waist!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the waistband is the strip of fabric that wraps around your waist on pants or skirts.

quests.instruction: We wear this that hangs down the front of a dress shirt. It is NOT your gloves. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It hangs down the front of a shirt!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a tie is a long piece of decorative cloth worn around the neck.

quests.instruction: We wear this that gets wet and dries quickly after a swim. It is NOT your wetsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear this to go swimming!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a swimsuit is made of special fabric that dries very quickly.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this when we want to keep our head warm in winter, not your helmet. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You tip this to say a friendly hello.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a hard hat protects construction workers from falling objects.

quests.instruction: What is the name for all the clothes we put on together for one day? It is also the collection that can be simple for school or fancy for a party, but it is NOT your apron!
quests.hint: Think about this: It is not one item, but a whole matching set.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Outfit is the name for the whole set of clothes you wear together!
quests.funFact: Did you know? an outfit is a complete set of clothes selected to be worn together.

quests.instruction: We wear this that keeps every drop of rain off our clothes. It is NOT your windbreaker. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It keeps rain from soaking your clothes!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Did you know? raincoats are made of waterproof materials like rubber or treated nylon.

quests.instruction: We wear this through the little loops on the top of our pants. It is NOT your scarf. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It goes around your waist!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a belt is a strap worn around the waist to keep pants from falling down.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this to keep our feet dry in wet, muddy weather, not your sneakers. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They reach up past your ankle.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Did you know? hiking boots have deep treads to prevent slipping on mud and rocks.

quests.instruction: We wear this to dress up as a superhero, animal, or fairy tale character. It is also worn instead of our regular clothes, just for pretend play, but it is NOT your onesie. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: It could turn you into a superhero or a dragon.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a costume is an outfit worn to look like someone or something else.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of a shirt and skirt worn separately, not your shirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It can be short or reach all the way to your ankles.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a wedding dress is traditionally white in many Western cultures.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that comes in two matching pairs, one for each foot, not your socks. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They have soles that touch the ground.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Did you know? running shoes have thick, bouncy soles to absorb shock.

quests.instruction: We wear this for a very fancy party, tied just below our chin, but it is not your cape. What is it?
quests.hint: It sits right at your collar.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a bow tie is a necktie tied in the shape of a bow.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of our regular clothes once bedtime arrives, not your uniform. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You change into these right before a story and sleep.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Did you know? some people love wearing onesie pajamas that cover them from head to toe.

quests.instruction: We wear this to keep the strong sunlight from hurting our eyes. It is NOT your cape. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They protect your eyes from bright light!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Did you know? sunglasses have tinted lenses to protect your eyes from bright light.

quests.instruction: We wear this made from a sturdy blue fabric called denim. It is also worn instead of soft cotton pants, for extra-tough play, but it is NOT your skirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: They are strong enough for climbing and rough play.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Did you know? jeans are tough pants made from a blue fabric called denim.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of separate pajama pieces, for cozy one-piece sleeping. It is also worn shaped like a favorite animal, with a soft hood and little ears, but it is NOT your costume. What is it?
quests.hint: It is all one piece, from top to bottom!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a onesie is a piece of clothing that covers the entire body in one garment.

quests.instruction: We wear this that slips over our head with no sleeves or buttons. It is also worn over our backpack to keep it dry in a sudden rainstorm, but it is NOT your coat. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: It drapes loosely over your shoulders.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a poncho is a single sheet of fabric with a hole in the middle for your head.
